Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Interface FaceSearchDatabase

All Superinterfaces:
java.lang.AutoCloseable
public interface FaceSearchDatabase extends java.lang.AutoCloseable
This application's face library, opened through HiFaceSdk.openSearchDatabase(context). The SDK manages its storage location and filename. Each call returns an independent connection to the same data; close it separately after use. Continuous camera search opens and manages its own connection automatically. All operations are synchronous and thread-safe; run them on a worker thread. Opening does not initialize models or take the camera engine lock. Stored face features are not encrypted. A library holds at most 50000 entries, with faceId unique across the library.

  • Method Details

    • saveFeatures

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> saveFeatures(@NonNull java.util.List<FaceSearchFeatureEntry> entries)
      Default batch-update entry: insert face features or replace all fields by faceId. Each batch contains 1..1000 entries and commits atomically. An invalid feature or write failure rolls back the entire batch; the last occurrence of a repeated ID wins. For image batches, extractFeatureBlocking one image at a time and write small batches. Aligned images are not required. If this handle will directly search afterward, call warmUp once for the actual scope after all batches, not after every batch.

    • saveFeature

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> saveFeature(@NonNull java.lang.String faceId, @NonNull java.lang.String feature, long updateTimeMillis, @Nullable java.lang.String tag, @Nullable java.lang.String group)
      Save one face feature. Replace all fields when faceId already exists; otherwise insert a new entry. For interactive duplicate-ID confirmation, call contains first. Prefer saveFeatures for batch updates.

    • updateMetadata

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> updateMetadata(@NonNull java.lang.String faceId, @Nullable java.lang.String group, @Nullable java.lang.String tag, long updateTimeMillis)
      Update metadata without writing a feature. Null preserves a value, and an empty string clears it. Provide at least one of group or tag. A timestamp of 0 uses the current time.

    • warmUp

      @WorkerThread @NonNull default HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> warmUp()
      Optional preload of the full face-library search cache. With no filters, equivalent to warmUp(null, null).

    • warmUp

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> warmUp(@Nullable java.lang.String group, @Nullable java.lang.String tag)
      Preload this handle's group/tag scope. Filters are combined with AND; null or an empty string means unrestricted. Each handle caches one scope. Changing the scope releases the previous capacity and reloads it, validating only selected features. Other database handles and camera-search sessions have independent caches and are not warmed up by this call.

    • releaseMemory

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Boolean> releaseMemory()
      Clear and release this handle's feature cache while keeping the connection and disk data. Use under memory pressure or when moving to the background. The next warmUp/search rebuilds it. Existing query results remain valid.

    • search

      @WorkerThread @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.util.List<FaceSearchMatch>> search(@NonNull java.lang.String feature, @NonNull FaceSearchConfig config)
      Decode a face-feature string and run an exact search. No match succeeds with an empty list. Results are ordered by score descending, then faceId in ascending UTF-8 binary order. Initial preparation, scope changes, or refresh after a write may read the database.

    • close

      @WorkerThread void close()
      Idempotent close. Other operations return CLOSED afterward. Does not close any HiFaceSdk inference instance.
